facts.fact: StackAdapt was named one of Canada's Best Managed Companies in 2024, according to a press release dated May 14, 2024.
facts.quote: StackAdapt named one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies in 2024

facts.fact: Canada's Best Managed Companies program only evaluates privately owned Canadian companies with revenues of $50 million or greater.
facts.quote: Celebrating over 30 years, Canada’s Best Managed Companies program awards excellence in private Canadian-owned companies with revenues of $50 million or greater.

facts.fact: The Canada's Best Managed Companies program has been running since 1993.
facts.quote: Every year since the launch of the program in 1993, hundreds of entrepreneurial companies have competed for this designation

facts.fact: Canada's Best Managed Companies awards are granted on four levels, with Platinum Club membership requiring Best Managed status for seven years or more.
facts.quote: 4) Platinum Club member, winners that have maintained their Best Managed status for seven years or more.

facts.fact: Gold Standard winners have retained their Best Managed award for 4-6 consecutive years, following three consecutive years of maintaining Best Managed status.
facts.quote: after three consecutive years of maintaining their Best Managed status, these winners have demonstrated their commitment to the program and successfully retained their award for 4-6 consecutive years

facts.fact: Canada's Best Managed Companies winners that re-apply and retain designation receive it for two additional years, subject to annual operational and financial review.
facts.quote: award recipients that have re-applied and successfully retained their Best Managed designation for two additional years, subject to annual operational and financial review

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes itself as used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is a multi-channel programmatic advertising platform used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.
